title: Nutty American Pasta Lasagna
description: A rich, springy, comforting American dish featuring Parmigiano-Reggiano and fermented kimchi, suitable for vegetarians.
instructions: Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
In a mixing bowl, combine ricotta cheese, Parmigiano-Reggiano, caramelized onions, garlic, salt, and black pepper. Set aside.
Transfer the cooked noodles to a baking dish and spread a layer of the ricotta mixture on top of the noodles.
Next, add a layer of fermented kimchi followed by a layer of lasagna noodles.
Repeat the layers of ricotta mixture, kimchi, and noodles until all the ingredients have been used.
Top the final layer of noodles with a mixture of Parmigiano-Reggiano, Panko breadcrumbs, and chopped fresh basil.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for another 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the dish is bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve hot and garnish with additional chopped basil, if desired.
